task: Optimal power dispatch for GB power system
named_methods: Linear programming optimal power flow (DCOPF transport model)
Load shedding with Value of Lost Load (VoLL) penalty
key_outputs: Optimal generator dispatch (per unit, per hour)
related_work_used: PyPSA: Python for Power System Analysis (Brown et al., 2018)
Open data and software in energy research (Pfenninger et al., 2017)
GB low-carbon power systems 2050 (Zeyringer et al., 2018)
implementation: Python 3.13, PuLP 3.3.0, CBC solver, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib
limitations: Transport model (no DC power flow physics)
No solar PV or offshore wind
Simplified cost structure (no start-up costs, min stable generation)
